detail: Concord Enviro Systems Limited - In continuation of our earlier intimation dated 4th July 2025, and pursuant to Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015, the NCLT Mumbai Bench has dismissed and disposed of the application filed by Ketav Consultant under Section 9 of IBC 2016 against Rochem Separation Systems (India) Private Limited, WOS of the Company vide its order dated 19th November 2026. |SUBJECT: Updates
